reason: The cited evidence (E1-E3) directly supports the existence of a compression-induced clustering-to-ordering transition in homogeneous Al0.1CrCoFeNi, but it does not address the key premise that a slight Al variation in a multilayer architecture would trigger this transition at interfaces, nor does it link the transition to enhanced creep resistance.
premises: Al0.1CrCoFeNi exhibits clustering over a wide temperature range for Al < 0.5
High-strain compression can induce a clustering-to-ordering transition in Al0.1CrCoFeNi
The transition is specific to compressive loading and does not occur under tension
The transition involves changes in pair correlations (increase in unlike pairs, decrease in like pairs)
A slight variation in Al content between layers can trigger this transition at interfaces
